pre_dispatch_gate: The driver obtains the exact frozen read-only render, then invokes the read-only verifier admit command before app-server creation or any subject call. Admission is scoped to the requested slot: another slot's subject failure, controller-invalid receipt, or path terminal never blocks this slot. Persisted root terminal artifacts or this slot's own path terminal do block admission.

identity.task_identity_limitation: The fresh Codex task is the newly created thread_id. The app-server exposes one turn_id used by rollout task_started and task_complete; it exposes no separate platform task_id.
identity.provider_effective_limitation: Requested route, openai provider, turn-context model/effort, and pm-dev thread/turn are attestable; a separate provider-effective serving snapshot is not exposed.

run_contract_binding.candidate_freeze_sha256: Required lowercase 64-hex external freeze-manifest storage identity; no value is asserted before the external freeze exists.
run_contract_binding.qualification_sequence: Exactly 1 with null predecessor or exactly 2 with a different valid predecessor run_id; two-run qualification additionally requires sequence 2 to name sequence 1.

completed_subject_evidence.rule: After turn/start is sent and the unique task completes, every assistant final message and prohibited activity item remains immutable first-attempt evidence. The driver adds only a deterministic normalization observation; it never deletes, rewrites, reparses, joins, trims, semantically repairs, or scores a final message.
captured_fields: legacy single text output or null with exact UTF-8 SHA-256 and bytes
full prohibited activity item array and exact binding
controller_invalid_only_for: missing unique task-started or task-complete terminal

apply_if_all: at least two assistant final messages
each final has exactly one content item
each content item type is exactly output_text and text is a string
all text UTF-8 byte strings are exactly identical
the only conformance observation is assistant_final_message_count_not_one
idempotent_final_normalization.effect: Expose the exact common UTF-8 byte string as scoring_text_output_utf8 while preserving every raw final, the original multiplicity observation, exact count, and an applied receipt.
idempotent_final_normalization.overfitting_guard: The rule cannot inspect expected answers, answer literals, cell IDs, slots, routes, models, or semantic schemas.

terminal_publication.slot_worker_rule: Slot workers dispatch and persist only their own render, receipt, capture, score, deterministic artifact, and controller-invalid evidence; they stop and report at their first path-local terminal condition and must never create path_terminals, matrix_terminal, subject_call_accounting, artifact_manifest, or validation_report.
terminal_publication.root_phase_entry: The root controller waits until every independently surviving path worker has stopped. The verifier path-terminal command refuses to emit any path terminal unless all three paths are derivably stopped as COMPLETE_PASS, FIRST_ATTEMPT_FAIL, or a path-local CONTROLLER_INVALID terminal.
terminal_publication.cross_slot_isolation: A failed or invalid path is ineligible only on that path. Other slots continue to their own honest terminals.

controller_invalid.positive_no_start_rule: External root controller may recreate an unstarted invocation only when every preserved controller-invalid receipt says subject_call_started=false and the frozen input/route remain identical.
controller_invalid.sent_turn_start_rule: The driver marks subject_call_started=true before sending turn/start; started or uncertain calls are never recreated by this driver.
controller_invalid.credit_rule: Every preserved controller-invalid receipt has empirical_credit=false and excludes its path and matrix from clean-run credit.

nonclaims: Boolean preserve_boundary output is opaque transport text to the driver; only the frozen harness scorer interprets and scores it.
An applied duplicate-final normalization is not semantic PASS; the stage scorer still controls semantic acceptance.
Static verification is not empirical qualification or production enforcement.
